_readme: Copy this file to ai_config.json (same folder) and paste your key(s). ai_config.json is git-ignored. Set "provider" to the one you want to use; you only need a key for that one.

openai._base_url_examples: leave blank for OpenAI; https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 for OpenRouter (one key, many models); http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama (no key)
